title: Lens Grinder
pages: Craft this t6 apparatus after the Heliostat Etcher (its Corona Fragment is collected from Lunar Essence, and the Noctilucent Condenser that makes the essence needs an etched Solar Prism) and before the Prism Separator, from a Corona Fragment (top left), a sealed steel plate (top right), attuned quartz, two optic powder, a Vitrified Grinding Wheel (centre), a resonance infuser (bottom centre) and two Retaining Rings (bottom corners) from the Flange Press. The wheel is the abrasive tool itself: craft a Green Grinding Wheel from four flint and four Aluminum Grit (abrasive grains) around a clay ball (vitrified bond), then fire it in the Clinker Oven. A vanilla grindstone or the unfired green wheel is rejected. The rings hold the wheel spindle and its bearings in place axially; sealed plates or flanged rings in those corners are rejected. This is a plain FE machine: no daylight, redstone or lumen condition gates it.

Twenty-four datapack grinding recipes turn glass, light sources and stone-adjacent blocks into fine materials. JEI shows the ingredient, FE per tick, output space and priority. Recipe type: arcana_industry:grinding; fields ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. A further recipe laps one Cemented Carbide Insert into a Lapped Carbide Seat (200 ticks, 16 FE/t), the stationary counter-face of the Mechanical Face Seal that the Phase Fermenter needs. Another grinds one Hardened Bearing Race into a Ground Tapered Race (160 ticks, 16 FE/t), the cup or cone of the Tapered Roller Bearing that the Prism Polisher needs. It also regrinds two hardened Tapered Rollers into one straight Cylindrical Roller (180 ticks, 16 FE/t); four rollers and two Hardened Bearing Races assemble the bearing required by the Prism Polisher. It also thread-grinds one Tool Steel Stock into a Ground Worm (220 ticks, 18 FE/t), the hardened worm of the Worm Gear Set that the Prism Separator needs.

The very first recipe grinds attuned quartz into a Ground Lens, a part with no other source. The Astral Relay now needs one Ground Lens in place of its fourth sealed steel plate: a bare plate there no longer completes that craft, so the Lens Grinder must be built before the Astral Relay. For the Prism Scorer, surround Tool Steel Stock with four tagged iron ingots to forge a Cam Blank, then profile-grind that blank for 220 ticks at 18 FE/t. The shaped, hardened cam controls the Scorer's repeated tool stroke; unground stock is not interchangeable.

Top and horizontal faces import; bottom exports. Each side is configurable in the GUI. Supply 16 FE/t or use the manual crank. Inventory, FE, progress and port modes persist; breaking drops inventory.
